PanelHeader.name: LuaPanelHeader
PanelHeader.Title: Lua stays close to the surface

Card.name: LuaCard1
Card.Title: Input
Card.Body: Tap, click, and selection handling can sit right beside the view that needs it.

Card.name: LuaCard2
Card.Title: State
Card.Body: Small state objects stay local, so the screen remains easy to reason about.

Card.name: LuaCard3
Card.Title: Binding
Card.Body: Let Lua connect the moving pieces while XML keeps the hierarchy in view.

Card.name: DeployCard1
Card.Title: Desktop
Card.Body: Best when you want denser information, more breathing room, and precision input.

Card.name: DeployCard2
Card.Title: Mobile
Card.Body: Responsive spacing keeps the same interface calm and touch-friendly on smaller screens.

Card.name: DeployCard3
Card.Title: Web
Card.Body: The same screen model can carry into browser workflows without being rewritten.

Card.name: FeatureXmlCard
Card.Title: XML stays readable
Card.Body: The layout tree is right there in the page, so structure and spacing stay easy to tune.

Card.name: FeatureLuaCard
Card.Title: Lua stays close
Card.Body: Interactions, bindings, and state can live next to the screen that owns them.

Card.name: FeatureShipCard
Card.Title: Ships everywhere
Card.Body: The same UI can move across desktop, mobile, and web-friendly targets.

Card.name: FeatureSpeedCard
Card.Title: Fast iteration
Card.Body: Edit, reload, and refine quickly without losing the overall shape of the interface.

GalleryCard.name: GalleryCard1
GalleryCard.Title: Lake Scene
GalleryCard.Subtitle: Real-time reflections and water surface rendered at 60 fps.

GalleryCard.name: GalleryCard2
GalleryCard.Title: Peacock
GalleryCard.Subtitle: High-fidelity texture sampling with anisotropic filtering.

WorkflowStep.name: Step1
WorkflowStep.Subtitle: Define Layout
WorkflowStep.Body: Write your screen as an XML file with familiar Grid and StackView containers.

WorkflowStep.name: Step2
WorkflowStep.Subtitle: Load Assets
WorkflowStep.Body: Images, fonts, and data files are streamed from packages at runtime.

WorkflowStep.name: Step3
WorkflowStep.Subtitle: Script Logic
WorkflowStep.Body: Attach Lua scripts to any component for interactivity and data binding.

WorkflowStep.name: Step4
WorkflowStep.Subtitle: Ship
WorkflowStep.Body: Deploy to desktop, mobile, or WebGL with a single build command.

Quote.name: Quote1
Quote.Title: — Alex R.
Quote.Subtitle: Lead Engineer
Quote.Body: ORCA lets us ship native-quality UI on every platform from a single XML source. It changed how we build products.

Quote.name: Quote2
Quote.Title: — Sam T.
Quote.Subtitle: UI Architect
Quote.Body: The declarative layout system is a joy to work with. Our designers write XML and developers hook up the logic — perfect split.

Quote.name: Quote3
Quote.Title: — Jordan M.
Quote.Subtitle: Game Developer
Quote.Body: Sub-millisecond frame times even on mid-range hardware. We ditched our old HTML renderer the day we tried ORCA.
